generate_image_embeddings: generate image embeddings from a text prompt using KandinskyPriorPipeline for Kandinsky image generation
interpolate_embeddings: interpolate image embeddings from mixed text prompts and images using KandinskyPriorPipeline with custom weights
encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the KandinskyPriorPipeline tokenizer and text encoder
prepare_latents: prepare noisy latent tensors for the Kandinsky prior diffusion process with a given shape and scheduler
get_zero_embed: get a zero image embedding tensor from the KandinskyPriorPipeline image encoder for unconditional guidance
